extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: car ferry (ro-ro), stylized and shortened to approx. 40.0 x 11.7 x 13.5 m (L x W x H incl. mast)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; stands on its flat bottom at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 1.9 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); open, empty vehicle deck with lane markings; separate moving parts with origin on their axis: ferry_bow_ramp (shown raised; hinge across the deck - rotate about +90 degrees around X in Blender to lower it forward, the hydraulic rams stay fixed), ferry_propeller_l/_r (spin around the shafts), ferry_rudder_l/_r (turn around Z); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no name, no text, no flag, no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
